literal: When the lover is absent, evening, like hostile strangers on an execution ground, comes.
translation: In the absence of my lover, the evening arrives like ruthless executioners entering a killing ground.
modern: காதலர் இல்லாதபோது, மாலைப் பொழுது கொலைக்களத்தில் வரும் பகைவர்களைப் போலக் கொடியதாக வருகிறது.
explanation: This couplet captures the deep anguish of a woman separated from her partner as night falls. The evening, which would normally be a time of joyful reunion, becomes a source of immense torment in his absence. The poet compares the arrival of evening to the arrival of hostile executioners (ஏதிலர்) on a killing field (கொலைக்களம்). Just as executioners bring swift and merciless death to those on the scaffold, the onset of evening ruthlessly assaults the lonely heroine's heart.
